description: This Python source file defines the `GCSBucketLogger` class, which extends functionalities for logging batch events asynchronously to Google Cloud Storage within an integrated system. It handles success and failure event logging, batch processing, and payload retrieval, and is tightly coupled with project-specific utilities and configurations.

classes.name: GCSBucketLogger
classes.description: A logger class that handles asynchronous logging of events to Google Cloud Storage within a batch processing framework, including success and failure events, with support for batching, time-based flushing, object naming, and payload retrieval.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a success event asynchronously by adding it to the internal queue for batch processing.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a failure event asynchronously by adding it to the internal queue for batch processing.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Processes queued logs in batch and uploads each log to GCS, handling errors on individual logs without failing the entire batch.

methods.name: str _get_object_name( self, kwargs: Dict, logging_payload: StandardLoggingPayload, response_obj: Any )
methods.description: Generates the appropriate object name for a log payload based on whether it is a success or failure and any metadata overriding.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_request_response_payload( self, request_id: str, start_time_utc: Optional[datetime], end_time_utc: Optional[datetime], )
methods.description: Fetches stored request/response payload from GCS based on request ID and time window, trying current, next, and previous days.

methods.name: str _generate_success_object_name( self, request_date_str: str, response_id: str, )
methods.description: Constructs an object name for a successful log with request date and response ID.

methods.name: str _generate_failure_object_name( self, request_date_str: str, )
methods.description: Constructs an object name for a failure log with request date and a UUID.
